text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaaaah------!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, the winner's interview is about to 
begin! The glorious champion of the Kikuka 
Sho is—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...We still have time, don't we!? Before 
that, Trainer—my phone!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Huh!? H-Hold on a—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(The ultimate result on the final stage of 
the Classic Triple Crown! So this time for 
sure—)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: (This time for sure—...!!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rrrr-ring... rrrr-ring...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Come on out already. You were watching 
this time too, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rrrr-ring— *click*!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ! Hello, Mother?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...What is it? Calling me at such a busy 
time—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: W-Wah... I did it! I won the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't it amazing?! Unbelievable, 
right?! Even you couldn't have imagined 
this, could you?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah, I get it. I get it, so just 
calm down a bit."

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"So— (*rustle*...) Did you win the Kikuka 
Sho? That's wonderful."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I took 1st place in that 
long-distance Classic race!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I really don't have what it takes as 
an Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Yes. That's true, I'll admit it."

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Now. Isn't this enough already? Surely 
you've made plenty of memories by now, 
haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"—So don't push yourself too hard, just 
come home."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Click*... *beep beep*...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Why...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Why do you say 'come back'?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why won't you tell me, 'I'm looking 
forward to your next race'...?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Nnngh!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, "I acknowledge you"?! 
How can you say that with a straight 
face?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I produced results worthy of 
it. Even though I worked this hard...!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Why won't anyone recognize me as a true 
Umamusume...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*tap-tap-tap...*)

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah, here you are! Everyone is waiting for 
you!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
I can hear it even from here! The crowd's 
high hopes for you taking 1st place—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the daughter of a GI 
Umamusume—!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You really showed them what a refined 
young lady can do! I'm sure your mother 
will be thrilled!!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
You're truly incredible! You definitely 
live up to your mother's name...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Is it the high-born lady everyone's 
waiting for? Or is it... me?

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Huh? Something like that is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Though she seems to be trying not to 
show it, King Halo looks quite pale."
choice_data_list: Shall we take a quick break?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And we had her interview schedule pushed 
back, deciding to let her rest in the 
waiting room.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if Special Week and the 
others are doing the interview right now 
in my place."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As a true protagonist, an Umamusume 
deserving of cheers. Next up, she's taking 
on the royal road of the Tenno Sho 
(Spring), right?
choice_data_list: Cut out jokes like that, please.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...How foolish of me. To think I actually 
wanted to be acknowledged.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: How truly shallow. To think this is...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—It's like you're giving them an opening 
to look down on you yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, the next day—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. I've been thinking ever 
since then.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I am King Halo, after all. A first-rate 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I am not a substitute for someone else, 
nor do I just stand alongside others. I am 
the one and only Umamusume standing at the 
top.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I believe I am the 
one who should gaze down upon everyone.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Rather than wishing to be acknowledged 
from below.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's why...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
choice_data_list: What do you want to do?
What do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure? Once you hear this, there 
might be no turning back for you either, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You really are my Trainer, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Very well, I shall grant you the right 
to hear what I have to say. Along with the 
privilege of continuing to serve me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now then......

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—Are you prepared to throw everything 
away?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The determination I heard from her that 
day was truly extraordinary—
